title.zh: 银会（向中标会员付款）条例 1972
title.en: Chit Funds (Payment to Successful Subscriber) Regulations 1972

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Chit Funds (Payment to Successful Subscriber) Regulations 1972.

2. In these Regulations, “successful subscriber” means a subscriber who has been declared the purchaser of a chit fund amount and who has furnished at least 2 guarantors acceptable to the chit fund company.

heading.en: Chit fund amount to be paid within 7 days

text.en: 3. A successful subscriber is entitled to receive the chit fund amount within 7 days from the date of being declared the purchaser of the chit fund amount.
